_comment: Non-secret settings. Secrets belong in the environment file (see consumer.env.example) so this file can stay world-readable. Any value here is overridden by its environment variable.
_allowed_senders: Lock a personal agent to yourself. AgentCall also enforces this server-side via the number's allowedSenders; this is the second lock. Empty list = anyone who texts the number reaches your agent.
_brain: How the consumer asks your agent for a reply. mode 'command' pipes JSON to stdin and reads the reply from stdout (exit 64 = deliberately say nothing). mode 'http' POSTs the same JSON and expects {"reply": "..."}.
_health_port: 0 disables the health endpoint. Set it (8787) for the Docker healthcheck or an external probe.
